symptom: Synthetic no-op Array.prototype[Symbol.iterator] skips remaining for-of required-field, monetary and unknown-field checks in the v224 Outcome Ledger candidate; regex match destructuring also loses captures, admitting an impossible Gregorian day after Date.parse normalization. No real research evidence corruption was observed.
lesson: Iterator-independent canonical hashing alone is insufficient when record admission and RFC3339 capture extraction still depend on mutable Array.prototype[Symbol.iterator]. An invalid record can pass the pre-digest gate, and an impossible date can be normalized by Date.parse.
guardrail: Use indexed loops for unknown/required/monetary/reconciliation fields and indexed RegExp captures. Regression-test empty iterators with invalid required fields, negative monetary values, unknown fields and impossible calendar dates under the canonical test runner.
